retrievalProfile.description: A multi-character montage featuring a central large portrait surrounded by smaller figures in diverse historical costumes against a solid black background.
triggerTerms: bold yellow serif title on black

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, high-contrast collage of a single male performer portraying multiple characters. A large, warm-toned headshot anchors the bottom center, while smaller full-body figures in costumes (Roman, Explorer, Cowboy, etc.) are distributed across a pitch-black field. Bold, colorful typography overlaps the imagery, creating a vibrant, kitschy 1960s aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central anchor portrait vs. smaller peripheral figures
Vibrant primary-colored text vs. deep black background
Theatrical costume variety unified by consistent lighting
Overlap of text and character figures to create depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large headshot at bottom center (approx. 40% height); five smaller full-body figures arranged in a semi-circle above and around it.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, smiling face at the bottom center with warm, golden-hour studio lighting.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large yellow title at the top, moves clockwise through the costumed figures, and settles on the large central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space fills the gaps between figures, emphasizing the cutout effect.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and Magenta (secondary text and costume details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in text and costumes against a zero-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Large x-height for readability against black
characterSpecificRedesigns: Dot on 'i' is often a perfect circle
Terminal of 'r' is a heavy teardrop shape

composition.overlap: Overlaps background and top of figures

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the main title paired with a heavy, slanted sans or slab for the secondary name.
graphicDevices: Small identifying captions next to each character

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy serif weight and mid-century editorial feel.
Alternative for a more playful, novelty-focused weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a collage of one man in five different historical costumes (Roman soldier, explorer, etc.) scattered across a solid black background, with one large close-up portrait of the same man at the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large yellow serif title at the top and a cyan slanted subtitle on the right. Add small identifying labels in magenta and yellow next to each costumed figure.

verificationChecks: Is the main title in a heavy yellow serif?
Is there a large central portrait at the bottom?
Are the costumed figures clearly separated from the background?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original performer
Specific historical names used in captions
postGenerationChecks: Check for solid black background without noise
Ensure text is legible and high-contrast
Verify the hierarchy between the large portrait and small figures
Confirm the 1960s novelty aesthetic is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Character Montage = (1 Large Anchor Portrait + 5 Small Costumed Cutouts) / Solid Black Background + (Heavy Serif Title [Yellow] + Italic Subtitle [Cyan])
